name: Coach Tinga — v3 Corrigé
_review_notes: SÉCURITÉ : remplacer les clés Supabase hardcodées par des variables d'environnement n8n.
Configurer dans n8n Settings > Environment Variables :
SUPABASE_KEY  = votre clé service_role Supabase (à régénérer)
EVOLUTION_API_URL  = URL de base de votre instance Evolution API
EVOLUTION_INSTANCE = nom de l'instance Evolution WhatsApp

parameters.jsonBody:
={{ JSON.stringify(Object.fromEntries(Object.entries({
  user_id: $('Check User & Route').item.json.user_id,
  channel: $('Check User & Route').item.json.channel,
  phone_or_chat_id: $('Check User & Route').item.json.phone_or_chat_id,
  onboarding_step: $('Check User & Route').item.json.onboarding_step,
  coaching_phase: $('Check User & Route').item.json.coaching_phase || 'ONBOARDING',
  prenom: $('Check User & Route').item.json.prenom,
  situation: $('Check User & Route').item.json.situation,
  situation_initiale: $('Check User & Route').item.json.situation_initiale,
  etat_initial: $('Check User & Route').item.json.etat_initial,
  defi_exprime: $('Check User & Route').item.json.defi_exprime,
  ecosysteme: $('Check User & Route').item.json.ecosysteme,
  deja_essaye: $('Check User & Route').item.json.deja_essaye,
  vision_reussite: $('Check User & Route').item.json.vision_reussite,
  last_active: new Date().toISOString()
}).filter(([k,v]) => v !== undefined && v !== null && v !== ''))) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({ user_id: $('Normalize Input').item.json.user_id, role: 'user', content: $('Normalize Input').item.json.message, onboarding_step: $('Check User & Route').item.json.onboarding_step, coaching_phase: $('Check User & Route').item.json.coaching_phase || 'ONBOARDING', timestamp: new Date().toISOString() }) }}
